passage.label: No if not desist drag forelock; lying sinning forelock; let call associates; call angels Hell; No do not obey him prostrate draw near

arabicExcerpts.text: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمۡ يَنتَهِ لَنَسۡفَعَۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ

mainSubject.label: If the transgressor does not desist he will be dragged by his lying sinful forelock; let him call his associates while the angels of Hell are summoned; the believer instructed not to obey him but to prostrate and draw near to Allah

subordinateSubjects.label: If he does not desist he will be dragged by the forelock
Let him call his associates challenged
The angels of Hell summoned in response
Do not obey him commanded; prostrate and draw near instead

commandsAndProhibitions.description: Prostrate and draw near to Allah.

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Lying sinful forelock identified as the locus of transgression
Associate-summoning met by Hell-angel summoning as divine counter

relationships.label: Prostration and drawing near prescribed as the believer's response to opposition

notes: Wave 13 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the teaching-by-the-pen declaration (5) before the transgression diagnosis opens (6); P2 ends with the divine-sight question (14) before the forelock-dragging threat begins (15); P3 runs through the lying forelock, the associate-challenge, the Hell-angels summons and the closing prostration command (15-19).
